name: black_mamba_hood_gape
description: Black mamba (Dendroaspis polylepis) reared in the warning pose, facing right: about forty percent of the olive-grey (#7f8865) body rises nearly vertically out of loose flat ground coils (x -260..+60, y -60..0), darker back, pale cream belly with scute lines, long coffin-shaped head held level with a heavy brow and a small dark eye. Anchor bottom-centre where the coils touch the ground; bbox about x -262..+200, y -450..0; head at about (+140,-420), eye (+152,-430). Same geometry as black_mamba_reared / _hood / _hood_gape (only the neck and mouth change). Narrow neck flap spread, jaws gaping wide to show the inky blue-black mouth lining (#0b0f2a, the only black part) and two small pale fangs; mouth centre about (+150,-415). No drool, no venom.
